question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Final query with integer cast for cleaner output
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        CAST(pr.qty AS BIGINT) AS running_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM packaging p
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        CAST(h.running_qty * pr.qty AS BIGINT),
        h.depth + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.contains_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT id FROM packaging
    WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
leaf_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT h.top_id, h.contains_id AS item_id, h.running_qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    WHERE h.contains_id IN (SELECT id FROM leaf_items)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        top_id,
        item_id,
        SUM(running_qty) AS total_qty
    FROM leaf_hierarchy
    GROUP BY top_id, item_id
    HAVING SUM(running_qty) > 500
)
SELECT 
    p.name AS container_name,
    pi.name AS item_name,
    t.total_qty
FROM totals t
JOIN packaging p ON t.top_id = p.id
JOIN packaging pi ON t.item_id = pi.id
ORDER BY container_name, item_name;
